create_new_stream: create a new CPU or CUDA stream for a given torch device
get_current_stream: get the current stream for a CPU or CUDA torch device
use_stream_context: use a context manager to switch to a specific CPU or CUDA stream
wait_stream_sync: make a source stream wait for a target stream to complete its queued work
record_stream_tensor: record a tensor on a CPU or CUDA stream to protect against reallocation
